title: High Star Formation Rates of Low Eddington Ratio Quasars at z ≳ 6
question: Do z~6 quasars with low Eddington ratios have high host-galaxy star formation rates, as expected if SMBH growth precedes prolonged star formation?

what.value: Rest-UV (Lbol, MBH, lambda_Edd) and FIR properties of z>~6 quasars compiled from literature

evidence.quote: Derived Rest-UV and FIR Properties of $z\gtrsim6$ Quasars from the Literature

external_data.citation: DeRosa11, Shen19, Decarli18, Mazzucchelli17, Willott10a, etc. (Table 3 refs)

what.value: Simulated evolutionary track of a BH and host from Smidt et al.

evidence.quote: we plot the evolutionary track of a BH in the simulation of (cite: Smidt18)

what.value: Lbol, MBH, lambda_Edd of IMS J2204+0112 and UV spectral properties

evidence.quote: This quasar has $M_{\rm BH}=1.23\times10^{9}~M_{\odot}$, and $\lambda_{\rm Edd}=0.11$

recipe.method: Fit 2D Gaussian to each continuum map with IMFIT
Fit modified blackbody to 250 GHz point, to two bands, and to eight SPW fluxes; integrate 42.5-122.5 um
key_parameters: Td=47 K, beta=1.6 fixed; also free Td and beta

assumptions: FIR flux arises mainly from star formation; Chabrier IMF

recipe.method: Estimate A_UV from LFIR/LUV using Calzetti00 eq. 7 for varying f_host
assumptions: Host is a starburst; LFIR dominated by host

recipe.goal: compare with literature quasars and simulation
recipe.method: Compute LFIR, Lbol, MBH, lambda_Edd, SFR for literature z>~6 quasars from single ~250 GHz flux; compare to Smidt18 track
key_parameters: 3 sigma upper limits for FIR-undetected; LEQ defined as lambda_Edd<0.2

evidence.loc: 3.1 Sub-mm Continuum Maps of IMS J2204+0112
3.1 Sub-mm Continuum Maps of IMS J2204+0112

evidence.quote: IMS J2204+0112 has the highest $L_{\rm FIR}/L_{\rm bol}$ value of 0.8
The lower limit of the UV extinction of IMS J2204+0112 would be $A_{\rm UV}>1.7$ or $E(B-V)>0.4$

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version used by the ALMA pipeline and pipeline version
Whether the pipeline continuum images used any specific weighting/robust or cleaning
Flux calibrator flux values and absolute flux scale uncertainty
Exact Lbol and MBH derivation inputs for the literature quasars (L3000, FWHM)
Fitting of lambda_Edd-dependent trend (red dotted line) method
Values of f_host and L_UV used for A_UV curves
missing_for_reproduction: Literature quasar input measurements (L3000, FWHM, 250 GHz fluxes) must be taken from cited papers
score_reason: Simple continuum analysis with pipeline images and clear formulas; literature compilation steps are less specified.
rediscovery_reason: Archive data public by ALMA policy, simple recipe and numeric results (fluxes, LFIR, SFR), though the data release status is inferred.
